name: staged-delivery-process
body:
The ordered, gated lifecycle a change-set follows end to end in the distributed `codebase-navigator` agent's process: write spec (`spec-writer`) → review spec (`spec-review`) → write plan skeleton (`plan-writer`) → review plan skeleton (`plan-review`) → write plan phases/tasks (`plan-writer`) → review plan phases (`plan-review`) → holistic plan review (`plan-review`) → implement (the owning `implementer`/`*-implementer`) → implementation phase review (`implementation-phase-reviewer`). Each stage has exactly one owning subagent, the stages are ordered, every stage runs, and implementation begins after the spec and the plan pass review green.

This entity is the macro lifecycle of a change-set, the ordered gated process the navigator's prompt states and follows. It is distinct from `domain.entity.task-execution-cadence` (the per-task commit → scan → mark-done ordering under the branch graph's staleness guard) and `domain.entity.subagent-session-isolation` (fresh isolated dispatches and the one permitted resume).
